prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean UV tanning beds or spray (airbrush/mist) tanning? Also, what part of Columbus are you in or willing to travel to (Downtown, Short North, Westerville, Hilliard, etc.)?

If you want a quick way to find the best salon near you, here’s what I recommend checking and asking before you go:
- Ratings and recent reviews on Google Maps, Yelp, and Facebook (look at reviews from the last 6–12 months).
- Cleanliness and photos of the facility.
- Services offered (stand-up vs lay-down beds, red light therapy, spray tanning booths or custom airbrush).
- Technician training/certifications for spray tanning (solution mix, color-matching experience).
- Bed types and last bulb change date (ask front desk).
- Pricing, packages, and membership plans.
- Hygiene practices (cleaning between clients, disposable eyewear).
- Cancellation/no-show policies and whether they require a patch test for spray tan.
- Safety questions: whether they screen for medications or skin conditions that increase UV risk.

If you tell me which neighborhood and whether you prefer UV or spray, I’ll list 3–5 top-rated salons in Columbus and include addresses/phone numbers and why they stand out.
